details: Introduction to Rebirthing Breathwork and how it can be used as a tool to regulate the central nervous system
bio: Jessica is a Rebirthing Breathworker currently in her final year of study. She shares a gentle, self-led and self-paced style of breathwork that supports participants to reconnect with their inner world at their own pace. Her work weaves intention setting, nervous system education and emotional awareness, supporting people to understand the language of their body, meet big emotions with presence and explore the patterns that shape their relationships.

details: Tree Holding Qi Gong really captures that harmony between grounding and flow. The phrase “Stillness in Movement” is especially powerful—it reflects the deep presence and calm awareness cultivated in
bio:
Hi, my name is Jamie Josephs. I’m the lead instructor at the Ballarat School of Jik Cheung Kung Fu in Ballarat Central, Victoria. Over the last three decades I’ve immersed myself in Jik Cheung Kung Fu, Western boxing, Tai Chi, and internal arts, earning my Second Degree Black Belt along the way. My teaching focuses on practical self-defence, situational awareness, personal empowerment, and close-quarter skills for students aged 16 and over.

At festivals I love sharing Tree Holding Qigong — a gentle yet powerful practice that brings together breath, posture, balance, and meditation. It’s an invitation to root yourself like a tree, calm the mind, reconnect with your body, and discover stillness within movement. My sessions are all about helping people find presence, inner strength, and a sense of peace.

details: I offer spiritual practices with simple explanations as to how they affect physiology. Using breathing/meditation/affirmations - I offer simple dally practices to help guide people home: to the self
bio:
Helen is a research scientist that has turned her hand to discovering more natural and holistic ways of healing. After working as a nutritionist for many years she learned that most people with an eating 'dis-order' are actually using food to conceal past trauma. Helen found that by shifting the focus from food to treating the underlying issues, she was much more successful at helping her clients change their eating behaviours.

Over the last 15 years Helen has been on a journey of self-discovery, delving into the healing power of meditation, breath, and nature. Coupled with her extensive scientific knowledge of nutrient interactions, and her holistic approach to treatment, she will introduce you a new way of living. One that is more in tune with your internal rhythm.

I am a student of life and love to learn. I have been many things. High flying corporate executive, University Lecturer, entrepreneur and founder, Board Director and Executive Leadership Coach.

I am beautiful, and I am spectacularly imperfect. I have lived both light and shadow deeply. And I am here.

details: Drop in, rest, receive. You'll be guided in a simple meditation while receiving VortexHealing - Divine Energy Healing. Think Reiki on steroids, with specific focuses that the group needs.
bio: Chris has been studying energy healing modalities for over 30 years, and professional healer since 2012. In the last 6 years, VortexHealing has become his main practice with clients due to its potency, precision, and depth, and how it gracefully leads you into deeper states of awakening.

details: We’ll use Futures Studies to reflect on scenarios we (un)consciously hold & define our best paths into whatever happens. Bring your thinking caps, joy in sharing, & lets explore our futures!
bio: Chris (BComm/Psych; MsSc Strategic Foresight) spent a decade+ facilitating groups to explore their futures, including NGOs, government departments, corporates, and industry bodies. Chris helped establish the Melbourne Social Forum 2004, project managed the Davos connected National Futures Summit 2006-2007, Co-Chaired the Australasian Node of UN's Millennium Project 2009-2012, was COO of the Centre for Australian Foresight 2012-2015. He’s published in futures journals (eg Humanicide: A Risk Profile for Humanity in the 21st Century) and through the Australian Foresight Institute on topics like Government Institutes of Foresight, and futures of philanthropy and not-for-profit sectors.

details: A sound activation and music accompaniment using the sacred AUM offers deep meditation, supporting stress reduction, mental clarity, emotional release, nervous system balance and self-connection.
bio:
Nectar of Sounds is a fusion of handpan melodies and conscious soundscapes, designed to transport listeners into deep meditative states. Blending rhythmic flow with harmonic resonance, these sounds offers a sonic journey that soothes the mind, awakens the senses, and fosters inner stillness.

On a personal level, Ali is a dedicated sound bath facilitator with a deep-rooted understanding of the human system through the lens of yoga and wellness. After 5 years of preparation and in 2013, he completed an intensive six-month advanced Hatha Yoga Teacher Training program in India, encompassing over 1,750 hours of rigorous sadhana. His training provided a profound foundation in the mechanics of yogic postures, the impact of sound and vibrations on the body and mind, mantras, anatomy and physiology, diet, the ancient science of Siddha, yogic philosophy, lifestyle practices, and the influence of the five elements. He spent 12 years living in the ashram where he undertook his teacher training, fully immersing himself in a disciplined yogic lifestyle and deepening his experential knowledge. Since completing his training, he has been teaching and sharing his knowledge, guiding individuals on their journey towards their inner wellbeing. With this holistic knowledge and experiences, Ali curates immersive sound experiences that promote deep relaxation, balance, and inner harmony, guiding participants on a journey of profound well-being.

details: Experience a transformative dance of leading and blindfolded surrender. Explore Shiva–Shakti energies in a playful journey of trust and polarity. Awaken vitality and meet yourself through movement.
bio: Klaudia is a lifelong explorer, passionate dancer, and a curator of events where people can nurture connection, and deepen the relationship with their body and soul. Tantra has been her path to growth and transformation and a way of finding more love, presence and joy in her life. Klaudia’s passion for dance stems from its power to reconnect us with our true essence—it is a gateway to inner wisdom, expression, and embodied freedom. Her heartfelt mission is to support others in awakening their raw, authentic selves and experiencing deeper embodiment, connection, and self-awareness.

details: Inspired by Pleasure Activism, this is an embodiment practice for Women & Femmes to resource their nervous system through the healing benefits of Pleasure. "Make the revolution irresistible!"
bio:
Jordhana is an Embodied Counselling Practitioner, Somatic Sexologist and Health Behaviour Change Coach. She completed her training at the Institute of Somatic Sexology, and Wellcoaches School of Coaching (USA). Jordhana is a certified member of the Somatic Sex Educators Association of Australasia and the Health Coaches Association of Australia and New Zealand and she specialises in Health, Pleasure and Embodiment Coaching for Women. 

Jordhana's practice is informed by her background in Naturopathy and Yoga Teaching, having completed her Bachelor of Health Science (Naturopathy) at the Southern School of Natural Therapies, and an Advanced Diploma of Yoga Teaching through the Australian Institute of Yoga Therapy.

Jordhana is deeply inspired by the work of Adrienne Marree Brown’s 'Pleasure Activism'. She sees Pleasure as an essential force for change in the world, both personally and collectively, and seeks to “make the revolution irresistible”.

bio:
I work in film and balance the madness with yoga. I had a school in Hepburn Springs and Melbs and love to share yoga in community cos it's more fun than on the mat at home alone. I offer yoga to a diverse bunch and recognise that we all need something different depending on age, experience, energy levels on the day and I encourage deep listening, responding and to lighten up a little (or a lot? ..about it all:) 
I love sharing yoga at festivals in nature and have done for decades.. x Lisa

details: This workshop provides an intro to non-duality spiritual teachings. We will explore how reality is a single undivided whole there is no distinct and separate 'me' that stands apart from the world.
bio: Shanti is an experienced facilitator of meditation and qi gong workshops, and is the author of the book 'The Peaceful Place - The Amazingly Simple Guide to Finding Peace Within"
